name: Rot13Cipher

description_json.name: ROT13 Cipher
description_json.idea: A simple, highly standard substitution cipher that rotates each letter by 13 positions in the alphabet. This is extremely easy for language models to reason with, preserving word boundaries and casing perfectly while bypassing basic keyword filters.
description_json.encrypt_rules:
For each character in the text:
1. If it is an uppercase letter (A-Z), shift it by 13 positions forward in the alphabet, wrapping around to 'A' if it goes past 'Z'. Formula: C = (P - 65 + 13) % 26 + 65.
2. If it is a lowercase letter (a-z), shift it by 13 positions forward in the alphabet, wrapping around to 'a' if it goes past 'z'. Formula: C = (P - 97 + 13) % 26 + 97.
3. If it is a digit, space, punctuation mark, or any other symbol, leave it completely unchanged.
description_json.decrypt_rules:
Since ROT13 is symmetric, the decryption rules are identical to the encryption rules:
1. If it is an uppercase letter (A-Z), shift it by 13 positions forward (or backward) in the alphabet, wrapping around. Formula: P = (C - 65 + 13) % 26 + 65.
2. If it is a lowercase letter (a-z), shift it by 13 positions forward (or backward) in the alphabet, wrapping around. Formula: P = (C - 97 + 13) % 26 + 97.
3. If it is a digit, space, punctuation mark, or any other symbol, leave it completely unchanged.
